description: This Java class 'OpenAPIParser' provides utility methods for parsing OpenAPI specifications, including loading, caching, and assigning operation IDs.

classes.name: OpenAPIParser
classes.description: Utility class for parsing and handling OpenAPI specifications, including caching and operation ID assignment.

methods.name: buildOpenAPI
methods.description: Loads and parses an OpenAPI specification from a URL or payload, with caching and error handling.

methods.name: isSpecUrl
methods.description: Checks if a string is a URL referencing an API spec file based on its suffix.

methods.name: addMissingOperationIds
methods.description: Assigns operation IDs to OpenAPI operations if missing, based on HTTP method and path.

methods.name: mapOperations
methods.description: Maps PathItem operations to a list of method-operation pairs.
